components.name: list
components.element:
<List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <TextField source="id"/>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>

components.name: create
components.element:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required()]}/>
   <TransformField expression="{choices: config.user.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))}">
    <SelectInput source="editor" validate={[required()]}/>
   </TransformField>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Entities">
   <ArrayInput source="entities" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <FunctionField render={record =>
        <TransformField expression="{expression: `[${typeof record === 'string' ? record : '{}'}]`}" record={record}>
         <Transform>
          {record => record.name}
         </Transform>
        </TransformField>
       }/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <TextInput multiline sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}} validate={[required()]}/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Config">
   <ArrayInput source="config" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <TextField source="name"/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <TextInput source="name" validate={[required()]}/>
       <TextInput multiline source="value" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}} validate={[required()]}/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Contents">
   <ArrayInput source="contents" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <TextField source="name"/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <TextInput source="name" validate={[required()]}/>
       <BooleanInput source="single" label="Single"/>
       <TextInput multiline source="options" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}} validate={[required()]}/>
       <TextInput multiline source="projection" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}}/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Components">
   <ArrayInput source="components" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator>
     <Accordion>
      <AccordionSummary expandIcon={
       <SvgIcon>
        <path d="M16.59 8.59 12 13.17 7.41 8.59 6 10l6 6 6-6z"/>
       </SvgIcon>
      }>
       <TextField source="name"/>
      </AccordionSummary>
      <AccordionDetails>
       <TextInput source="name" validate={[required()]}/>
       <TextInput multiline source="element" sx={{'.MuiInputBase-input': {fontFamily: 'Courier New'}}} validate={[required()]}/>
      </AccordionDetails>
     </Accordion>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>
